AboutPage.title: About us
AboutPage.description: Two master's students in physics who wanted to make student life at Ulm University simpler and clearer.

jan.bio: Jan is a master's student in physics at Ulm University and develops the Ulmiversität website. With his technical background and interest in web development, he built this platform to make everyday university life easier for students.

stefan.bio: Stefan is also a master's student in physics at Ulm University and takes care of the website's quality assurance. He ensures that all content is correct and up to date and meets students' needs.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: As students, we know the typical everyday challenges: finding lecture halls, checking the canteen menu, keeping track of important dates. With Ulmiversität, we wanted to create a central hub that makes this information clear and quickly accessible.

independence.title: Independence
independence.text: Important: We are completely independent of Ulm University and the student representation (StuVe). We develop this platform externally and on our own initiative.

contact.title: Contact & feedback
contact.text: Do you have questions, suggestions, or feedback? We look forward to hearing from you!

Exmatriculation.title: Unenrollment
Exmatriculation.description: Not sure whether you want to continue your studies? Our quiz helps you decide.
questions: Are you satisfied with your studies overall?
Do you feel that your degree program suits you?
Are you coping well with the workload?
Do you think the mensa prices are fair?
Do you see clear prospects after graduating?
Do you have enough support (e.g. counseling, friends)?
Does the content of your studies motivate you?
Would you choose your degree program again?
Exmatriculation.shareText: Ulmiversität's quiz on whether unenrolling is the right choice for you.
